docs.purpose: Serves a live preview of the sales leads — from building permits and committee-of-adjustment applications — that a specific supplier account would see, based on that supplier's registered trade categories, so an admin can check or demo what a given supplier's feed looks like.
docs.data_story: It reads 5 tables — `suppliers`, `supplier_trades`, `trades`, `lead_trades` and `trade_forecasts` and writes nothing. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 12 fields, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. **Nothing in this repository calls it.** That is the state this registry exists to make visible, not a claim that it is dead — a caller could be a bookmark, an external system, or a path built from variables.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` is the field that matters most here: today it is empty, and the orphan panel renders that as a red row rather than leaving it to be discovered years later.

notes: Deliberately an ADMIN-facing preview (verifyAdminAuth plus an explicit supplier_id param), not a supplier-authenticated endpoint — the header calls out that a true external supplier login is future scope. CoA-type leads are included only when the LEAD_FEED_DISABLE_COA env var is explicitly '0' (default keeps them off), mirroring the main lead feed's killswitch. No in-repo caller found. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: FINDINGS. (1) BEST-GUARDED of my six: verifyAdminAuth is genuinely the first line (:34), input is fully Zod-validated (types.ts:9-15), pagination is clamped, and the SQL is parameterised end-to-end (src/lib/admin/supplier-leads.ts:112-117). (2) CENSUS DISAGREEMENT: census_reads [suppliers, supplier_trades, trades, lead_trades, trade_forecasts] are ALL confirmed, but the census MISSES `profiles`, read on every request through verifyAdminAuth (src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:117-120), and the conditional `admin_backup_codes` read behind the MFA gate. census_writes [] is confirmed — I looked, this route writes nothing. (3) TRAP CHECK: `lead_type` at src/lib/admin/supplier-leads.ts:52 is a CASE expression alias, not a table; `st`, `t`, `lt`, `tf` (:61-65) are aliases for supplier_trades, trades, lead_trades and trade_forecasts respectively. (4) Two separate round-trips to establish existence then fetch (src/lib/admin/supplier-leads.ts:88 then :90, then :112) — three queries where the existence check could be folded in; not a correctness bug. (5) The 401 at :36-39 bypasses the err() helper (see envelope.deviations). (6) The `(lt.tier <= 1 OR lt.confidence > 0.55 OR lt.attachment_basis = 'inference')` predicate at src/lib/admin/supplier-leads.ts:71 embeds the literal 0.55 in SQL; the file header (:11-16) explains its history and FORBIDS raising inference-row confidence past it. That is a comment; the enforced code is the predicate at :71 — the 0.55 itself is a magic number in SQL, not a logic variable. (7) No SELECT *. | Caching: none observed — no Cache-Control, revalidate, dynamic or in-process cache in the route or in src/lib/admin/supplier-leads.ts. | Pagination: limit/offset WITH a clamp: src/app/api/admin/suppliers/leads/types.ts:13 caps limit at 200 (default 50) and :14 forces offset >= 0 (default 0); applied as `LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4` at src/lib/admin/supplier-leads.ts:77 and bound at :112-117. meta.count/limit/offset echoed at route :70-75. No total-count query, so a client cannot tell a last page from a full one. | Other guards / classification: LEAD_FEED_DISABLE_COA env killswitch at :54 — `!== '0'` means CoA leads are OFF unless the env var is exactly the string '0'; the value is passed as $2 into the SQL at src/lib/admin/supplier-leads.ts:74. No CSRF check applies (GET is not in MUTATING_METHODS, src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:45). MFA aal2 gate applies via src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:143-173 only when ADMIN_MFA_ENFORCED='true'. | ORPHAN — zero call sites in src/** or mobile/** (sweep 2026-09-15, comment lines stripped). | No test file under src/tests/** imports this route.
